summary: Honeywell International Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the spin-off of its Aerospace Technologies business into an independent publicly traded company, Honeywell Aerospace Inc. The spin-off was completed via a pro rata distribution of all Honeywell Aerospace common stock to Honeywell shareholders of record on the distribution date. The filing includes entry into a Separation and Distribution Agreement, a Tax Matters Agreement, and a Trademark License Agreement to govern post-spin relationships and allocate assets, liabilities, and obligations. No financial terms (e.g., price/share, premium) are provided as this is a tax-free spin-off for U.S. holders. What to watch: trading in the two stocks post-distribution, potential index rebalancing, and any subsequent M&A activity for either entity.
